sections.title: SHORT PARAGRAPH
sections.text: This is a short single-line paragraph for testing text section rendering.

sections.title: MULTIPLE PARAGRAPHS AND LONG TEXT
text: First paragraph: Engineering laboratory records require clear formatting, structured layout, and consistent line spacing. The LabRecord Engine provides a flow-based rendering system for typesetting engineering notes.
Second paragraph: Long text paragraphs automatically wrap cleanly within the configured page margins without overflowing horizontally or vertically.

Third paragraph: When content exceeds the height of the available printable page area, the flow-based layout engine automatically splits paragraphs across page boundaries and continues rendering at the top of the next page.
Fourth paragraph: Repeat testing paragraph to ensure page continuation works seamlessly without dropping any lines of text or clipping bottom text margins.
